summary:
Doujin = sources whose post is a BOOK (BooruHandler.hasReader == true). Nine site handlers live in lib/src/boorus/doujin/ + lib/src/boorus/nhentai_handler.dart: nhentai (v2 REST API), niyaniya/hdoujin (SchaleHandler, Schale JSON API, clearance-gated reader), asmhentai (HTML), eahentai (JSON API + HTML fallback), hentalk (FaccinaHandler, faccina REST), hitomi (gg.js + nozomi range reads + B-tree text index), hentaipaw (HTML fetched through a headless WebView on the site origin), e-hentai/exhentai (HTML + api.php, pages resolved one at a time), plus the virtual DoujinForYouHandler (sources/local style feed that fans facets out over the configured doujin sources and hands each card back to its own handler via handlerForItem).
Every handler extends BooruHandler; most mix in DoujinNamespacedTags (tags stored BARE, namespace kept in a per-instance side map; tagNamespace() feeds detail-page sections), several mix in CatalogSuggestions (autocomplete from pulled tag lists) and DoujinListingTagBackfill (cards paint first, gallery pages fill tags in). Each owns a TagCatalogSource (tag builder). All speak a query protocol carried in the tab string: id:<id>[/<key|token>], related:<id>, recommend:<id> (+ nhentai versions:<id>, favorites:me; asmhentai/eahentai random:). Related/Recommended are generated by DoujinRecommendationEngine (title tokens incl. CJK bigrams, tag overlap, same-work exclusion, artist cap, personal taste via RecommenderHandler) unless the site has a list (nhentai related, hitomi related, schale similar, e-hentai newer/parent via gdata).
loadItem registers the page list in ReaderHandler.books (keyed by postURL); DoujinDetailPage (what a doujin card tap opens instead of the viewer; also embedded in the floating preview and hosted as a doujin TAB), DoujinReaderPage (layout-contract reader), the card menu, the viewer toolbar and SnatchHandler all read it. e-hentai registers placeholder pages (MediaType.needToLoadItem) resolved on display through paced lanes, with page thumbnails cut from per-block sprite strips (SpriteTile) on scroll.
Personal doujin data is the DoujinDataHandler singleton (GetX RxMap/RxList/RxSet fields, doujinData.json beside settings.json): favourites (+ account sync via toggleFavouriteSynced), collections (bookmarks are collection entries), followed artists, history (cap 1000, 800 ms gathered writes, tags learned later), saved searches, pins, starred tags, doujin search history. save() writes the whole file synchronously and pings DrawerRefresh. Its static predicates (doujinTypes, isDoujinBooru/isDoujinSource/isDoujinItem, knownDoujinHosts, sameDomain, doujinBooruForItem, hostOf) are used app-wide (BooruItem.isHidden/isMarked, BooruHandler filtering, DatabaseHandler, SettingsHandler, SearchHandler, SnatchHandler) to keep doujin and booru data separated. Reading progress is the ReaderProgress table in store.db via ReaderHandler (memory cache, fire-and-forget writes).
Downloads: SnatchHandler queues pages with a DoujinDownloadInfo; DoujinDownloadHandler creates <root>/Doujin/<host>_<id>/ (plain dir or SAF), names files by place in book (001.ext), writes doujin.json; scan() reads the root, earlier download folders and legacy loose <source>_<n>.ext files; DoujinDownloadsPage lists and opens books in the reader from disk.
Sessions: eahentai bearer token (EaHentaiSessionHandler, eahentai_session.json), e-hentai forum cookies kept OUT of the shared cookie jar (EHentaiSessionHandler, ehentai_session.json, exhentai igneous probe + 24 h recheck), Schale clearance (SchaleClearanceHandler: visible solver window + headless harvester + headless page client on robots.txt, schale_clearance.json per network), OriginPageClient (headless WebView fetches for hentaipaw's WAF). main.dart runs runDoujinMigrationIfNeeded + mergeLegacyBookmarks at startup, flushes the gathered doujin write on pause and drops both page clients on resume.
Library UI: DoujinFavouritesPage, DoujinDownloadsPage, DoujinFavouriteTagsPage, DoujinCollectionsPage (main drawer, doujin tab), and DoujinFavouritesListPage / DoujinHistoryPage / DoujinFollowedPage / DoujinSavedSearchesPage / DoujinCollectionsPage from the drawer quick-access rows. Per-source knobs (reading direction, quality, tap zones, cover display, detail layout, language filter, blacklist…) live in SourceSettingsHandler (sourceSettings.json, not assigned here).

features.name: nhentai source (v2 API)
features.navPath: Tab with an nhentai source -> search bar / search window filter chips
features.what: Newest listing (/api/v2/galleries) or search with site syntax passthrough; underscores -> quoted spaced values; sort chips (Newest/Popular/today/week/month), category chips, language chips; tag names resolved from tag ids (/tags/ids, session cache); CDN servers fetched once per run; stable server pick per path; title order per Title language setting; scanlator line; favourites count as score; upload date.
features.storedIn: memory only (static caches); config in boorus.json / sourceSettings.json

features.name: nhentai per-source content filters in every search
features.navPath: Settings -> Doujin -> nhentai (Source settings) -> Only show language / Blacklist
features.what: Language filter and per-source tag blacklist are appended to every ordinary nhentai search (language:"x", -tag:"y"); an empty feed with filters becomes a pages:>0 search so filters apply.

features.name: nhentai account favourites sync + Account favourites feed
features.navPath: Doujin detail page -> heart; Main drawer (doujin tab) -> Doujin favourites & bookmarks -> Account favourites
features.what: With an API key, favourite toggles POST/DELETE /galleries/{id}/favorite and report the result under the buttons; favorites:me opens the account favourites as a paged feed.

features.name: Account blacklist import (nhentai, e-hentai My Tags)
features.navPath: Settings -> Doujin -> <source> (Source settings) -> Import blacklist from my account
features.what: fetchAccountBlacklist reads /api/v2/blacklist (nhentai, API key) or /mytags hidden/negative-weight tags (e-hentai, login) and returns bare tag names for the per-source blacklist.

features.name: nhentai Related chapters & versions (versions:<id>)
features.navPath: Doujin detail page -> 'Related — chapters & versions' strip
features.what: Phrase search on the gallery's pretty base title (subtitles/volume markers stripped); bounces through the detail endpoint when the title is unknown (restored tab).

features.name: nhentai blended recommendations (recommend:<id>) incl. endless mode
features.navPath: Doujin detail page -> Recommended strip (and open in new tab)
features.what: Site related list + searches on artist and the 3 most distinctive tags, scored by tag overlap + title similarity, same-work excluded, artist results capped, tilted by personal taste and reported as exposed; Recommended count 0 = endless paging through deeper bucket pages.

features.name: nhentai comments
features.navPath: Viewer/detail -> comments page for an nhentai gallery
features.what: Comments from /galleries/{id}?include=comments with avatars on the i-servers.

features.name: Doujin tag suggestions (site endpoints)
features.navPath: Search bar on a doujin tab -> type
features.what: nhentai /tags/search, e-hentai api.php tagsuggest, eahentai /search/suggestions, schale title-word suggestions; typed and namespaced suggestions.

features.name: Catalog suggestions (autocomplete from pulled tag lists)
features.navPath: Search bar on asmhentai / hentalk / hitomi / hentaipaw tab -> type
features.what: Answers from BooruTagStore rows in the catalog's search spelling; 'ns:partial' narrows the namespace; says 'no tag lists pulled yet' instead of an empty miss.

features.name: Tag builder catalogs for every doujin source
features.navPath: Search window -> Tag builder chips -> download icon (pull)
features.what: nhentai prefix walk (36 prefixes, expand full ones), asmhentai/hentaipaw paged indexes (80/70 pages per pull, resumable), eahentai letter x page shards, hitomi letter pages + languages + types, schale 3-request /books/tags paced 4 s, faccina one devalue __data.json, e-hentai EhTagTranslation GitHub files parsed off-thread; rows carry namespace, type, count, hentaipaw sourceId.

features.name: niyaniya / hdoujin (Schale) browsing
features.navPath: Tab with a NiyaNiya or HDoujin source -> search window Sort/Language/Category chips
features.what: Latest (/books) or Popular shelf (/books/popular; per-source default sort decides the empty query), category cat= (doujinshi/manga/illustration), search s= with bare tags re-qualified and underscores to spaces; mirror domain resolved from the base redirect (shupogaki.moe); reduced Chrome UA + Origin/Referer headers; preview dimensions; favourites count as score.

features.name: Schale reader (clearance-gated page list) + image quality
features.navPath: Doujin detail page (niyaniya/hdoujin) -> Read; Settings -> Doujin -> <source> -> Image quality
features.what: POST /books/detail?crt= then GET /books/data/...?crt= made from inside the site's page (page client) with Dio fallback; quality 780/980/1280/1600/Original with Koharu fallback order; 429 back-off shared across tabs from x-ratelimit-reset; refused token logged with traces and dropped.

features.name: Schale 'Complete the check' clearance flow
features.navPath: Doujin detail page (niyaniya/hdoujin) -> 'Failed to load details' row -> Complete the check
features.what: Opens the visible solver window ('Reader access') on the refused gallery, with refused token removed from localStorage and diagnostics injected; closes itself when the site stores a clearance or the auth host answers 403/429; harvester reads localStorage headless; 429 holds the button 60 s ('Wait Ns') with snackbar; 403 snackbar explains address refusal and network-toggle workaround; then reloads.

features.name: Schale image CDN fallback
features.navPath: automatic
features.what: thumbnails.fallback host kept in item.sources and offered via thumbnailFallbacks; ownsPost recognises Schale posts (mirrors, hdoujin subdomains, configured sites).

features.name: Schale Related = site 'similar' list
features.navPath: Doujin detail page -> Related strip
features.what: With a clearance token the gated detail's similar list is shown; without one a generated list stands in.

features.name: asmhentai source
features.navPath: Tab with asmhentai -> search window Language/Category chips, Metatags 'Random gallery'
features.what: Listing/search, single namespaced term routed to /artist|tag|.../<slug>/ taxonomy pages, random: gallery, tags from link slugs with counts, page images from the per-gallery shard path, generated Related/Recommended (top candidates' tags filled).

features.name: Site form logins (asmhentai, hentalk)
features.navPath: Settings -> Booru edit page -> Username / Password fields
features.what: POST /login/ (asmhentai) or /login (faccina) form; session cookie kept in memory on the handler and sent on site requests.

features.name: eahentai source (JSON API)
features.navPath: Tab with eahentai -> search window Sort / Search in / Quick filters chips
features.what: latest/popular/search v2/random/album endpoints; sorts latest/today/weekly/monthly/alltime; type artist/character/parody/tag; quick filters appended as site words; category chips map to Doujins/Manga; language chip ignored (English-only site, 'english' language tag added to every item); HTML/next-payload fallback parsers.

features.name: eahentai login, bookmarks shelf, lists shelf, bookmark sync
features.navPath: Settings -> Doujin -> eahentai (Source settings) -> Log in / Log out; search window -> My bookmarks / My lists; detail page heart
features.what: POST /api/auth/login -> bearer token stored with username and the login name (changed credentials re-login), /auth/me username, /lists/mine lists; bookmarks: and list: shelves; heart POST/DELETE /api/bookmarks/<id>; 401 on account calls logs out; refused credentials not retried for 10 min; site refusal text shown; password body excluded from logs.

features.name: Detail cover from the first page (e-hentai, eahentai)
features.navPath: Settings -> Doujin -> <source> -> Detail cover from first page; Doujin detail page cover
features.what: A sharper cover (gallery page 1) fades in over the listing thumbnail, sharing the reader's cached file name.

features.name: e-hentai / exhentai source
features.navPath: Tab with e-hentai -> search window Shelf / Favourite category / Categories / Language / Options chips; Metatags
features.what: Shelves latest/popular/watched (login)/favorites (login, favcat 0-9)/toplists (yesterday, month, year, all time); category mask f_cats; expunged/torrent; rating/pages/uploader metatags; bare tags re-qualified to their namespace; forward-only cursor paging per query (32 queries kept); extended + compact listing parsing; content-warning skip; blank exhentai / login bounce / unreadable display-mode messages.

features.name: exhentai site variant with automatic fallback + daily access re-check
features.navPath: Settings -> Doujin -> e-hentai (Source settings) -> Site choice; Account -> Check again
features.what: exhentai used only when the session has a usable igneous; otherwise e-hentai with one log line; a 'mystery' refusal re-asked behind a page after 24 h (1 h after a failed probe). Post URLs always spelled on e-hentai.org.

features.name: e-hentai session kept out of the cookie jar
features.navPath: Settings -> Doujin -> e-hentai -> Log in (EHentaiLoginPage) / Site settings / My Tags / Watched buttons
features.what: Forum cookies copied into ehentai_session.json and scrubbed from the jar; sent only to site requests (Cookie header with nw=1 and sl=dm_2); media gets Referer only; jar scrubbed once per run when the source is first used; buttons seed the jar for the visit and scrub afterwards.

features.name: e-hentai pages resolved on open (paced lanes)
features.navPath: Reader / detail pages grid / Save all on an e-hentai gallery
features.what: Gallery load registers placeholder pages; each page resolves its block keys once then the image via showpage (showkey learned) or the page view; requests paced 300 ms on a priority lane and a bulk lane for whole-book downloads; 509 quota message; expired links re-resolve on image error.

features.name: e-hentai page thumbnails from sprite strips
features.navPath: Doujin detail page pages grid / reader filmstrip (e-hentai)
features.what: Tiles read one block at a time as they scroll into view (shared request, skipped when all waiters scrolled away, 30 s back-off after failure); expired strips forget the block's tiles and re-read later.

features.name: e-hentai Related (newer versions + parent) and Recommended
features.navPath: Doujin detail page -> Related / Recommended strips
features.what: Related via api.php gdata of #gnd links + parent; Recommended from tag/title searches ranked by the engine.

features.name: hentalk (faccina) source
features.navPath: Tab with hentalk -> search window Sort / Order chips
features.what: /api/library?q= with app syntax translated to faccina's (quoted spaced values, - and ~ prefixes, bare tags re-qualified); sort created_at/title/pages/random and order asc; self-hosted base URL; covers/pages /image/<hash>/<n>.

features.name: hentaipaw source via WebView page client
features.navPath: Tab with hentaipaw -> search window Shelf (Latest/Daily ranking) / Language chips
features.what: All pages fetched by a headless WebView parked on robots.txt (WAF 403 for plain HTTP) with Dio fallback; namespaced single term routed to /tags/{id} when the tag builder knows the id, else keyword search; language from card flags; viewer document parsed for every page URL; client dropped on app resume.

features.name: hitomi source
features.navPath: Tab with hitomi -> search window Sort (popular) / Type / Language chips
features.what: gg.js parsed (refreshed hourly) for image/thumbnail URLs; one range request per page for single-term queries; multi-term intersection/negation over 20k-id windows; language index read whole; free-text B-tree search; per-source language filter & title language; visible 'hitomi changed' errors; Related = hitomi's own list with same-work entries floated first.

features.name: Per-source 'Only show language' and 'Title language' (e-hentai, hitomi, nhentai)
features.navPath: Settings -> Doujin -> <source> (Source settings)
features.what: A language term joins searches that name none; two titles ordered by preference.

features.name: Browse filters spec (search window chips)
features.navPath: Search window on any source with doujinFilters
features.what: DoujinFilterSpec/Group/Option: the choice travels in the query as key:value terms (selected/apply/strip helpers), defaults shown checked; reused by booru sources.

features.name: Listing tag backfill
features.navPath: automatic (niyaniya, asmhentai, hentaipaw feeds)
features.what: After a page paints, gallery pages are fetched (throttled per source) to fill card tags so blacklist, stars and hidden/marked checks work; cached per session; grid repaints.

features.name: Namespaced tags, bare names
features.navPath: automatic; Doujin detail page tag sections
features.what: Tags stored as bare lowercase_underscored names with the site namespace on the side; namespace -> TagType mapping; legacy inline prefixes still grouped; qualifyTag puts the namespace back for search.

features.name: Generated Related / Recommended engine
features.navPath: Doujin detail page -> Related / Recommended strips (most sources)
features.what: Base title, CJK bigram title tokens, tag-overlap score, same-work to Related, artist cap 15% (min 2), personal taste +-0.25, dismissed removed, exposure logged; Related filled by title/series/author closeness.

features.name: Doujin For You feed
features.navPath: Main drawer (doujin tab) -> For You (doujin world) / doujin For You tab; ⋮ menu seed
features.what: History mode (top-scored read galleries -> character/parody/act/artist facets on rotating sources) or seed mode (seed:ns:x), -tag/filter: constraints, dominant reading language added on nhentai/e-hentai/hitomi, one request per source lane, 15 s page timeout, read/served items excluded, one retry round, recommender rerank and exposure; error text when no source / no history.

features.name: Doujin favourites (local store, account-synced)
features.navPath: Detail page heart; card menu; double-tap; Main drawer quick access -> Favorites
features.what: Favourites in doujinData.json keyed by postURL, newest first; toggleFavouriteSynced pushes to the site when supported and returns a status line ('Saved locally — <hint>' when not).

features.name: Bookmark = collection entry

features.name: Doujin favourites & bookmarks page

features.what: Account favourites row (favorites:me tab, enabled with an API key), Local favourites row, and the bookmark collection's entries newest first with swipe-to-remove and tap opening id:<n> as a tab.

features.name: Doujin favourites list page

features.name: Doujin history (auto) + history page

features.name: Doujin collections page

features.what: List with counts, FAB 'New doujin collection' dialog, delete with confirm, collection detail list (newest first) with swipe-to-remove and tap to open.

features.name: Followed doujin artists

features.name: Doujin saved searches

features.name: Doujin search history

features.name: Starred (favourite) doujin tags + Favourite tags page

features.name: Doujin pinned tags

bugs.title: WebView page client start never completes on load timeout (hentaipaw fetches hang)
bugs.scenario: robots.txt load on hentaipaw.com stalls past 15 s without a main-frame error (slow/captive network) -> every pending pageClient.fetch() (listing, gallery, viewer, tag backfill, catalog shard) awaits forever; the feed/detail spinner never ends
bugs.evidence: _start() returns done.future; on timeout `await done.future.timeout(timeout, onTimeout: () {...return false;})` only yields false locally, then `if (!ok) await dispose();` — `done` itself is never completed (only onLoadStop/onReceivedError/catch complete it), and _starting is reset in finally so callers already holding done.future never resume

bugs.title: Schale page client start never completes on load timeout (reader load hangs)
bugs.scenario: niyaniya robots.txt in the headless page client does not finish within 12 s -> SchaleHandler._gated awaits clearance.pageRequest forever -> detail page stays on the spinner, Read never enables, no Dio fallback
bugs.evidence: Same pattern as OriginPageClient: `final bool ok = await done.future.timeout(pageClientTimeout, onTimeout: () {... return false;});` never completes `done`; pageRequest does `if (!await _startPageClient(siteUrl)) return null;` on done.future

bugs.title: Swiping away a doujin favourite bypasses toggleFavouriteSynced
bugs.scenario: nhentai (API key) or eahentai (logged in) favourite removed by swipe in Favorites list -> still favourited on the site account; cards already loaded keep a filled heart (item.isFavourite not reset); no unfavourite event reaches the recommender
bugs.evidence: onDelete: `store.favourites.remove(e.postURL); store.save();` while DoujinDataHandler documents toggleFavouriteSynced as 'THE favourite entry point… Every UI path must go through this so account sync can never be skipped'

bugs.title: Followed artist tap builds a query most sources cannot read
bugs.scenario: Followed artist 'some_artist' tapped -> nhentai gets artist:""some artist"" (double quotes), e-hentai artist:"some_artist"$ (underscores kept, no match), asmhentai routes to /artist/"some-artist"/, faccina/schale send underscored quoted value -> empty or wrong results
bugs.evidence: addTabByString('artist:"${f.tag}"') with bare underscored tags; NHentaiHandler._siteTerm: value = body.substring(colon+1).replaceAll('_',' ') keeps the quotes then wraps in quotes again; EHentaiQuery.siteTerm keeps a pre-quoted name verbatim; AsmHentaiHandler.taxonomyPath regex captures the quotes into the slug; FaccinaHandler/SchaleHandler.translateQuery pass tokens containing '"' untouched

bugs.title: Bookmark tap opens id:<n> on the drawer's source without key/token
bugs.scenario: Bookmark collection holds a niyaniya or e-hentai gallery; user opens 'Doujin favourites & bookmarks' from an nhentai tab and taps it -> id:<n> searched on nhentai (wrong gallery or nothing); on the right source after a restart Schale/e-hentai fail with 'needs the gallery key/token'
bugs.evidence: onTap: _openTab('id:${bookmark.serverId}') with customBooru: widget.booru; the library pages' _openEntry uses SearchTab.doujinIdQueryFrom(serverId, postURL) (adds /key) and _booruForHost(entry.booruHost)

bugs.title: 'Account favourites' row enabled on sources that have no favorites:me feed
bugs.scenario: asmhentai/hentalk/eahentai config with a password in the key field -> row enabled -> tap opens a tab searching 'favorites:me' as text (asmhentai /search/?q=favorites:me, eahentai q=me) instead of account favourites
bugs.evidence: hasKey = widget.booru.apiKey?.isNotEmpty; only NHentaiHandler._parse understands favorites:me; on asmhentai/faccina/eahentai apiKey is the password (apiKeyLabel 'Password (optional)')

bugs.title: Loading the next page cancels the previous page's tag backfill
bugs.scenario: niyaniya feed (1 request per 500 ms) scrolled to page 2 before page 1's 25 cards got tags -> remaining page-1 cards never get tags this session: blacklist, starred-tag and hidden/marked checks never apply to them, tag strip stays empty
bugs.evidence: afterParseResponse runs for every page (booru_handler.dart:391) and does unawaited(_backfill(newItems, ++_generation)); workers stop when generation != _generation, so the older page's pass returns early

bugs.title: Read button never shows 'Continue · p.N' after an app restart
bugs.scenario: Read half a book, restart app, open its detail page -> button says 'Read · N pages' (tapping still resumes, because openDoujinReader loads progress)
bugs.evidence: _actionRow uses ReaderHandler.instance.cachedProgress(...) only; loadProgress is called only in openDoujinReader/openLocalDoujinReader (doujin_reader_page.dart:906/932), never by the detail page

bugs.title: Doujin For You source rotation is always 0 on the first page
bugs.scenario: First load of the doujin For You feed always starts at the first configured source instead of a random one
bugs.evidence: search() calls await _init(tags) (which sets _rotation = sources.length <= 1 ? 0 : random) BEFORE _refreshSources() fills `sources`; on first init sources is empty

bugs.title: Schale id: items carry raw untyped tags
bugs.scenario: Gallery reopened from favourites/history (id:<id>/<key> tab) or used as Recommended source -> card tags are TagType.none with original casing and no namespace (no sections/types, not the normalized form backfill uses) until the detail page loads; Recommended passes no sourceArtist so the artist cap is off
bugs.evidence: _itemFromDetail builds Tag(t['name'].replaceAll(' ', '_'), tagType: TagType.none) instead of tagsFromDetail(detail); _fetchRecommended calls rankPersonal without sourceArtist

bugs.title: Multi-term hitomi query results cached for the handler's lifetime
bugs.scenario: Tab searching 'female:x language:english' refreshed later in the session -> same id list served, new galleries never appear until the handler is recreated
bugs.evidence: _resolvedIds[cacheKey] filled once and never cleared or aged; only single-term queries bypass it

bugs.title: Concurrent gated call reports 'needs a check' while a harvest is running
bugs.scenario: Two gated loads start without a stored token (detail page load + card menu Read) -> second gets harvest() == null immediately and shows the clearance message even if the first harvest finds a token
bugs.evidence: if (_harvesting) return null; caller SchaleHandler._gated treats null as needsSolveMessage

bugs.title: nhentai catalog pull cannot resume past shard 0 in a new session
bugs.scenario: A pull interrupted at shard N and resumed after a restart starts at shard N with an empty _queue -> returns null immediately, pull treated as finished
bugs.evidence: _queue is filled only when shard == 0; `if (shard < 0 || shard >= _queue.length) return null;`
